gate_checks.detail: mean_pLDDT=75.0, 40.2% (158 res) < 70 pLDDT, 158 low-confidence surface residues (AlphaFold).

flags: ATOMIC_BUNS_AMBER: 16 buried unsatisfied polar atoms (A:E17:N, A:D21:N, A:Y107:N, A:L111:N, A:S149:N)
ML_ROTAMER_UNCERTAINTY_RED: 40.2% residues have pLDDT < 70; surface SAP/SCM may fluctuate with rotamer jitter
recommendations: Inspect surface hydrophobic patch residues (A:V10, A:P12, A:P13, A:L14, A:F19); if not required for target binding, resurface with polar/charged residues.
Attenuate clustered positive surface charges (Arg/Lys) to lower non-specific binding and clearance risk.
Satisfy buried polar atoms via internal H-bond networks or replace with hydrophobic packing.
Sample conformational/rotamer ensembles on low-pLDDT (<70) surface regions before acting on single-frame SAP or charge patches.
